title: GoHighLevel Automation Specialist: CRM, Lead Management and Workflow Automation

facts: Post: UK plumbing, heating and property maintenance business using GoHighLevel with Tradify and QuickBooks.

Post asks: capture enquiries from forms, email, phone, missed calls and WhatsApp; quiet-lead follow-up; missed call and voicemail workflows; internal notifications; reduce duplicate entry between GHL, Tradify and QuickBooks; review requests.
No first name in post; business name used per U-006. Content reused from tour/ built 2026-10-22 19:08 CT.

items.body: Sorry we missed you. Reply here or we'll ring you back shortly.
Hi, it's Hannah. We've had no hot water since last night and the boiler shows an error. Two little ones at home.
No hot water, call back now. {{lead.name}}, {{lead.phone}}. Sent to the office app and the on-call engineer.
Hi Hannah, thanks for the message. It's Sam from the office, I'll ring you in the next few minutes to sort a visit.
Thank you, I'm in all morning.

content.notice: Sam checked the AI draft before sending. The AI never messages a customer on its own.
